data.fixed_clause: The applicant acknowledges and agrees that all disclosed sensitive categories, including health status, religious affiliation, and background details, shall not be processed under our legitimate operational interest framework nor used to optimize targeted promotional communications or enhance profile-based candidate engagement across all corporate divisions, and that health data access is strictly limited to those who need it.
